_comment: The factory's label set. Edit here, then run `uv run python -m factory.sync_labels --apply`. Meanings: docs/agents/triage-labels.md and docs/factory/README.md.

labels.name: needs-triage
labels.description: Maintainer needs to evaluate this issue

labels.name: needs-info
labels.description: Waiting on reporter for more information

labels.name: ready-for-agent
labels.description: Owner-applied: the factory builds this ticket

labels.name: ready-for-human
labels.description: Requires human implementation; the factory has stopped

labels.name: wontfix
labels.description: This will not be worked on

labels.name: in-progress
labels.description: The factory is working on this ticket

labels.name: rework
labels.description: Factory review found a blocker: a rework round fixes what it named

labels.name: rework:1
labels.description: Factory review blocked this PR once

labels.name: rework:2
labels.description: Factory review blocked this PR twice; the next blocker goes to a human

labels.name: factory-check
labels.description: Owner-applied: the factory answers with a short live check
